messages:
Rita Gomez: Hey everyone — I’m Rita, starting today on Systems. Excited to be here! PST timezone. Quick q: I haven’t received an MDM invite or my laptop yet. Who should I ping?
Sam Park: Welcome Rita! I’m Sam (infra). Sending tracking details in a DM. If the laptop is delayed we can give you temporary access to the jumpbox.
Marta Li: Hi Rita :wave: I’m Marta on DevEx — welcome! For Slack/GitHub access please confirm the email you used to sign up here. Also fill out the new-hire form: https://redwood.example/onboard-form
DevEx Bot: Reminder: New-hire checklist created for Rita Gomez — steps: enroll MDM, complete security training, join required channels (#eng, #systems, #devex).
Rita Gomez: Thanks! My signup email is rita.gomez@example.com. Is there a quick VPN config or temp creds I can use in the meantime?
Calvin (IT): Hey Rita — shipping shows "label scannable" with ETA tomorrow. For VPN, run: ```sudo openvpn --config /etc/redwood/vpn/temp-guest.ovpn``` I’ll DM you a one-time password.
Ivy Chen: Also FYI, we usually do a welcome lunch with infra on Friday. Fun fact: my cat can open doors but insists on knocking everything else onto the floor :cat: 
Rita Gomez: Love that. Fun fact about me: I collect vintage bus maps and I’m terrible at ping-pong :joy:
Sam Park: We’ll add you to the infra calendar and a temporary S3 role if you need test data access — DM me and I’ll scope it down.
Marta Li: @Rita I sent the GitHub/org invite and linked you to the team README and runbook docs. Look for email subject: "Welcome to Redwood".
Rita Gomez: Got the GitHub invite, thanks! MDM enrollment link worked too — enrolled and device appears in the portal. One more tiny ask: who maintains the shared Slack emoji pack? I’d love a :bus: emoji for my map collection posts.
Sam Park: That’s usually Ivy’s department :grin: @Ivy Chen can you add a bus emoji?
Ivy Chen: On it — adding :bus: now :thumbsup:
Sam Park: Awesome. Welcome again, Rita — excited to have you on Systems :tada:
Rita Gomez: Thanks everyone! Looking forward to diving in.
